column1: # ZAP rule configuration (D18), for zap-baseline.py and zap-full-scan.py (-c): rule id, tab, WARN | IGNORE | FAIL, tab, name.
# Rules not listed stay WARN. FAIL fails the scan job; WARN goes to the encrypted report.
# (10038 is a WARN on staging, whose CSP is report-only by design: security-scan.yml.)
# jt_consent (consent banner, D1) and NEXT_LOCALE (locale switcher) are read or written by the page script: not HttpOnly on purpose.
# State-changing requests carry the CSRF header (§6), not a form token.
# Cloudflare's own responses, not the app's: the WAF block page that answers /sitemap* to anything but a
# verified bot (infra/cloudflare/waf-rules.json) and the /cdn-cgi/ files it loads carry none of the app's
# headers (scan of 30 Oct 2026: HSTS, nosniff, CSP, CORP, Permissions-Policy). Out of scope: "*" becomes a context
# exclusion (not crawled), the rule ids an alert filter (still fetched, never counted). Both are Java full matches,
# hence the trailing .* (zap-baseline.py of ZAP 2.17.0, Automation Framework mode).
